purpose: Constrain calibration-image colour screening to literature-supported within-species morph contrasts. These are candidate states for calibration, not final labels.

Ipomoea purpurea.diagnostic_scope: corolla background pigmentation; treat throat/rays/spots as secondary unless they prevent assignment
Ipomoea purpurea.structure_note: Flower colour is genetically multi-locus. White versus pigmented and pink versus blue/purple are distinct axes; this flat image code is a pragmatic phenotype screen and must not be treated as a single allelic series.

sources.support: pink versus blue P/p morph axis and spatial clustering
white versus pigmented flower-colour morph contrast
natural corolla colours range from white through blue and pink

Raphanus sativus.diagnostic_scope: petal background colour; visible venation or local markings do not independently define a morph

sources.citation: Stanton et al. 1987, American Journal of Botany
sources.support: white, yellow, pink, and bronze petal-colour forms
yellow var. lutea and orange var. aurantiaca phenotypes

Dactylorhiza sambucina.diagnostic_scope: overall fresh flower/inflorescence background morph; spots and markings are not separate morphs

sources.support: stable yellow- and purple-flowered morphs in natural populations

Antirrhinum majus.diagnostic_scope: whole-corolla pigment distribution pattern, not background hue alone

state_definitions.magenta_pseudomajus_like: predominantly magenta corolla with restricted yellow patch near the flower face/entry region
state_definitions.yellow_striatum_like: predominantly yellow corolla with restricted magenta veins/markings
state_definitions.intermediate_or_other: fresh and visible but does not cleanly match either canonical pattern

sources.support: pseudomajus is magenta with a small yellow patch; striatum is yellow with restricted magenta veins

Lysimachia arvensis.diagnostic_scope: overall fresh corolla background; central dark structures are not a separate morph

sources.citation: Ortiz et al. 2015, Perspectives in Plant Ecology Evolution and Systematics
